# Margins MCP

> Margins MCP is a free, local-first MCP server that lets Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and compatible AI clients read, search, and propose writes to an Obsidian or Markdown vault without an API key.

Margins runs on your machine against a folder of Markdown files. It exposes a small set of tools that Claude can call — search the vault, read individual pages, follow wikilinks and backlinks, and stage write proposals to a `proposed/` folder you review before accepting. Your notes never leave your disk.

It's built for Obsidian power users but works with any folder of `.md` files.

## Install

- Download the `.mcpb` bundle: https://github.com/cflorczyk9/Margins/releases/latest/download/margins-mcp.mcpb (double-click; Claude Desktop installs it)
- Or via npm: `npm install -g margins-mcp` then `margins-mcp install --vault /absolute/path/to/your/vault`

## Tools exposed to Claude

- `margins_start` — vault primer with file counts, last edit, and suggested queries
- `search_vault` — full-text and filename search
- `read_page` — fetch one file by path
- `list_recent` — most recently modified files
- `get_backlinks` — pages linking to a slug
- `propose_page`, `propose_edit`, `append_to` — stage writes to `proposed/`
- `list_proposals`, `resolve_proposal` — review and accept or reject proposals
- `propose_compile_from_raw` — turn a raw transcript into a structured source page
- `search`, `fetch` — ChatGPT Deep Research compatibility pair

## Differentiation

- vs Filesystem MCP: Margins is vault-aware (wikilinks, backlinks, vault primer) and has a propose-then-accept safety model. Filesystem MCP gives Claude raw direct file access with no review step.
- vs Smart Connections: Margins uses your Claude subscription (no BYOK), works in Claude Desktop and Claude Code (not in-Obsidian only), and supports writing back.
- vs NotebookLM: Margins is local. Your files stay on your disk; NotebookLM requires uploading to Google.

## Pricing

Free. MIT-licensed. The only ongoing cost is your existing Claude Pro or Max subscription.

## Limitations

- Requires Claude Desktop or Claude Code; not yet supported in the claude.ai web interface (no MCP there yet).
- Markdown only as of v0.5. PDF and DOCX support is on the roadmap.
- No embeddings or semantic vector search in v0.5. Keyword + filename + wikilink-graph retrieval only.
